about: One task card with every field (NASL-EMS-HBK-001 section 5.2). A project keeps all its cards in one file: {about, updated, gates: [...], cards: [...]} (for Shaddad tools/dashboard/project_cards.json). Successors are not written: every tool derives them from the predecessors.

card.title: Power and BMS: preliminary design
card.purpose: A pack, BMS and power design that meets the energy, thermal and safety requirements with the real pack
card.description: What the task is, the work it involves, how it is done and what it delivers, in three to six sentences for someone new to the project. A list may follow a blank line: one item per line, each starting with '- '.

exit.gate: G2 PDR for power passed (feeds G3-PWR)
criteria: The energy budget closes with the margin of the project plan

risks.risk: The sealed pack cannot be cooled passively
risks.mitigation: Shade, a charging limit or active cooling (decision 4)

escalation.when: A cooling or charging limit that changes the operating concept

status: todo (= planned, kept for older files)

size.M: two or three engineers, or two passes
size.XL: every subsystem or several safety chains (split it if you can)

rules.entry_criteria: facts a person can check: true or false
rules.exit_criteria: measurable; together they are the card's acceptance
